task: Predict minor_category of a card transaction; major_category is derived from a fixed taxonomy.
intended_use: Auto-labelling of card transactions; use the returned confidence to route low-confidence cases to review. Refunds are set by a deterministic rule (status refunded or positive amount) applied after the model.

training_data.split: temporal, first 80% by created_at; test starts 2026-05-24T11:07:07+00:00

model_description: TF-IDF + categorical + numeric features, sigmoid-calibrated LinearSVC.
excluded: card_name and identifier columns are accepted by the API but not used.

selection.criterion: CV accuracy (desc), then CV macro-F1 (desc), then CV log-loss (asc), then model name (asc); a candidate with any non-finite CV score ranks after every fully valid candidate; scores are rounded to 12 decimals before comparison so float noise never decides a ranking; 5-fold stratified CV on the training period

limitations: Labels are noisy per merchant (same merchant carries several labels), so errors on ambiguous merchants are expected.
Merchants unseen in training are much less accurate; see seen_unseen metrics.

The headline figure is guarded next-period accuracy (refund rule applied) under the current merchant mix. Cold-start accuracy is also guarded and is measured by title-grouped CV on the training period (reported in metrics.json).
Trained on a single three-month window of EUR card transactions; drift is not monitored.
Class imbalance: small classes (e.g. hairdresser) have fewer examples; see per-class report.
